picks.title: Comparative Cost of Care Recommended by Large Language Models versus Treating Physicians
picks.excerpt: NEJM AI study evaluating 24 AI models: LLMs are increasingly consulted for clinical decision support, yet the cost of the services or treatment they recommend had not been systematically compared with what treating physicians actually ordered. (Online date verified via Crossref.)
picks.rationale: This NEJM AI study compares the cost of care recommended by 24 LLMs with what treating physicians actually ordered. Clinicians already consult these models for decisions, and no one had measured the cost side before. It also has a real figure image.

picks.title: 씨어스, UAE 아부다비 보건부 IRB 승인… UAE 최초 AI 부정맥 국가검진 사업자 선정
picks.excerpt: 씨어스가 UAE 세하클리닉과 추진하는 국가 건강검진 프로젝트로 아부다비 보건부 IRB 승인을 받았다. 40세 이상 자국민 연 1회 국가검진에 웨어러블 AI 부정맥 스크리닝을 도입하기 위한 최종 파일럿이다. (게시일: 본문 '16일 밝혔다' 기준)
picks.rationale: Abu Dhabi's health department granted IRB approval for the final pilot that puts wearable AI arrhythmia screening into the UAE's annual national checkup for citizens aged 40 and over. A regulator signed off, and the tool will reach patients at population scale.

picks.title: Radiology department uses AI to identify lung cancer screening patients in EHR
picks.excerpt: UC Irvine developed a natural language processing tool that extracts smoking history and identifies lung-cancer-screening-eligible patients from free-text clinical notes.
picks.rationale: UC Irvine's radiology department runs an NLP tool that reads free-text notes for smoking history and finds patients who qualify for lung cancer screening. Under-enrollment in that screening is a well-known gap, and this is a working hospital deployment aimed at it.

picks.title: Automated differentiation for parkinsonism using clinical structural MRI: A multicenter study
picks.excerpt: A T1-weighted structural MRI-based AI model differentiates Parkinson's disease from multiple system atrophy using routine clinical scans across multiple centers, avoiding costly research-grade multimodal MRI.
picks.rationale: This multicenter model tells Parkinson's disease apart from multiple system atrophy using routine clinical T1 MRI, a hard differential diagnosis that otherwise needs research-grade scans. It is fresh, open access and comes with a figure image.

picks.title: [2026 국감] "AI 시대에 의료영상 삭제, 재산 없앤 셈"…심평원 데이터 관리 도마
picks.excerpt: 심평원이 저장공간 부족을 이유로 과거 의료영상 데이터를 삭제하고 삭제 기준·표준화도 갖추지 못한 사실이 16일 보건복지위 국정감사에서 질타를 받았다. 의료 AI 학습용 공공 원천데이터 관리 문제.
picks.rationale: At a National Assembly audit, Korea's health insurance review agency (HIRA) was criticised for deleting historical medical images to free up storage, with no deletion criteria. Those images are public source data for training medical AI, so this is regulator-level accountability.

alternates.title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient-Physician Communication (AI-INFO)
alternates.excerpt: NEJM AI original article (AI-INFO) testing whether AI-generated summaries of patient documents handed to physicians before the visit change consultation time and patient-physician communication. Abstract behind Cloudflare at collection time; online date verified via Crossref.
alternates.rationale: A strong clinical trial, but the abstract is Cloudflare-blocked and there is no image, so the excerpt is thin. First alternate.

alternates.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction - Development and External Validation
alternates.excerpt: NEJM AI original article developing and externally validating an AI-enhanced (digital stethoscope) auscultation model to flag left ventricular dysfunction at the point of care. Abstract behind Cloudflare at collection time; online date verified via Crossref.
alternates.rationale: A point-of-care diagnostic study, but it has the same thin-excerpt and no-image problem. Second alternate.

dedup.note: The pool had 18 candidates and 4 history_match tags, with no clusters. DROPPED as the same story: (1) STAT Clairity direct-to-patient (likely-repeat, 0.473). This is the Clairity/Everlywell consumer launch already published 10-08 via AuntMinnie. (2) Radiology Business 'adapting adult radiology AI models to pediatric population' (untagged). It covers the same Nature BME paper published 10-14 (s41551-026-01812-6), and the 10-16 curator dropped it for the same reason. (3) STAT 'AI sandboxes' (related). This is commentary on the state-regulation lobbying story published 10-15, with no new decision. Parkinsonism MRI (related to the 10-08 Parkinson telerehab RCT) was KEPT: it is a different study and a different task (MRI differential diagnosis of PD vs MSA, not rehab). Riverain-on-platform (related to the 10-08 FDA bone-age card) is a different company and event, but it was dropped as stale (10-06) and as a distribution deal. DROPPED as lower priority: the NEJM AI AI-INFO and auscultation papers (thin Cloudflare-blocked excerpts, no image; kept as alternates); CPT codes for CCTA AI (10-09, explainer); osteoporosis CXR (10-09) and infant motion screening (10-08), passed over for fresher npj; 3billion ASHG (company conference presentations); careCycle Medicare tool (plan comparison, weak clinical tie); JAMA Netw Open public-perceptions survey (survey only, dropped on 10-16 too). Diversity: medigatenews 2, nejm 1, radiologybusiness 1, nature 1, for 4 distinct outlets. No pick touches biosecurity or gain-of-function.
